summary_en: EDIAND completed tender offer for Nissin Shoji shares (2026-05-12 to 2026-06-22). 3,921,070 shares tendered, exceeding minimum threshold of 2,291,500. EDIAND to acquire all tendered shares, becoming parent company and lead major shareholder with 58.73% voting control as of 2026-06-29 settlement. CEO Tsutui Hiroaki (EDIAND representative) owned 3.30% of Nissin directly pre-offer.
title_en: Notice on Results of Tender Offer for Nissin Shoji Shares by EDIAND Co., Ltd. and Changes in Parent Company and Lead Major Shareholder
translation_en_brief: EDIAND Co., Ltd. (a newly incorporated investment vehicle established 2026-04-20) conducted a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Nissin Shoji Co., Ltd. from 2026-05-12 through 2026-06-22. The tender offer received 3,921,070 share tenders, exceeding the stated minimum threshold of 2,291,500 shares and qualifying as successful. EDIAND will acquire all tendered shares. As of the settlement date (2026-06-29), EDIAND's voting stake will reach 3,921,070 votes out of 6,676,444 total votes (ex-treasury), representing 58.73% voting control. This stake causes EDIAND to become both parent company and lead major shareholder. EDIAND is 100% owned by Tsutui Hiroaki, who is also CEO of Nissin Shoji; Tsutui directly held 220,400 Nissin shares (3.30% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury) prior to the offer. ENEOSHoldings, previously the lead major shareholder, will drop to ordinary major shareholder status following settlement.
